Dear Dr. Linda Myers,

I am writing to request a medication evaluation appointment to assess the effectiveness of my current medication regimen, particularly in light of my recent experiences with elevated cortisol levels, moderate to severe grief, and anxiety. As you are aware, I have been dealing with the aftermath of a miscarriage, a pending legal case, and the financial implications of a bankruptcy filing.

I would like to schedule an appointment to discuss my current mental health status, including my PHQ-9 depression score of 18 and anxiety score of 12. I have been coping with my emotions through mindfulness meditation, journaling, and attending therapy sessions. However, I would like to evaluate my medication to ensure it is optimally managing my symptoms.

Could we schedule an appointment at your earliest convenience to review my medication regimen and make any necessary adjustments? I appreciate your time and expertise in helping me navigate this challenging period.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Sincerely,
Andrew Cross
